entity_raw.definition_raw:
You are skilled at drawing quality maps, making your cartographic works both more useful and more valuable when sold.

Prerequisite: Craft (maps) 3 ranks.

Benefit: You gain a +4 bonus on Craft (maps) checks when creating a map, as well as 1 additional Discovery Point (see Discovery Points). If you succeed at the check by 5 or more, the list price of the map increases by 20%.
